synopsis: This notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) encourages applications to establish a Rapid-Acting Psychotropic Interventional Drugs - Clinical Trials Network (RAPIDs-CTN). The overarching purpose is to generate actionable, real-world evidence to guide the safe and effective implementation of RAPIDs in routine clinical practice, answering urgent questions about how these treatments can be delivered sustainably outside tightly controlled experimental settings. This NOFO utilizes a milestone-driven UM1 Cooperative Agreement mechanism structured into two operational stages: Stage 1 (Years 1–2) for network establishment and pilot studies, and Stage 2 (Years 3–5) focuses for full-scale execution of proposed pragmatic trials. This program is intended only for large-scale, coordinated network projects that could not be achieved using other, more standard grant mechanisms.
title: Advancing Real-World Effectiveness Evidence for Rapid-Acting Psychotropic Interventional Drugs (RAPIDs) (UM1 Clinical Trial Required)
